matches.title: Middlesbrough vs Wrexham
matches.description: Watch Middlesbrough vs Wrexham highlights and goals from Carabao on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on August 7, 2026. The stadium lights shone brightly as two ambitious sides clashed in a Carabao Cup tie filled with tactical intrigue. Both teams entered the pitch knowing that efficiency in front of goal would be the deciding factor in who progressed to the next round. A Balanced Opening Exchange On August 7, 2026 , Middlesbrough hosted Wrexham in a match that burst into life from the opening whistle. The hosts nearly took an early lead in the 7th minute when Adilson Malanda saw his close-range effort heroically saved by Danny Ward . Middlesbrough continued to apply pressure, with Will Lankshear forcing another sharp save from Ward just eight minutes later as the Boro looked to capitalize on their home advantage. Wrexham , however, were far from passive. Nathan Broadhead sent a header agonizingly wide following a pinpoint cross from Callum Doyle , and Oliver Rathbone tested the atmosphere with a long-range strike that whistled over the bar. Despite the high energy and a flurry of corners for the home side, the first half ended without a breakthrough, leaving everything to play for in the second period. Lankshear Breaks the Deadlock The deadlock was finally broken in the 61st minute as Middlesbrough ’s persistence paid off. A clever headed pass from Sebastian Berhalter found Will Lankshear on the right side of the box. The young forward composed himself before driving a low shot into the bottom left corner to make it 1-0. The goal sparked a reaction from Wrexham , who made a triple substitution shortly after, introducing Kieffer Moore , Bailey Cadamarteri , and Benjamin Whiteman to find an equalizer. As the clock ticked down, the game became increasingly physical. Sam Smith was booked for simulation, and Will Lankshear also saw yellow for a mistimed challenge. Middlesbrough almost doubled their lead in the 87th minute when Morgan Whittaker led a lightning-fast break, only to see his shot cannon off the right-hand post. Late Pressure and Final Whistle In a frantic finale, Wrexham threw everything forward. Callum Doyle forced a late save from Sol Brynn in the 89th minute, while a series of corners kept the Middlesbrough defense on high alert. Tactical fouls led to yellow cards for Dominic Hyam and Doyle as they struggled to contain the hosts' counter-attacks during stoppage time. Ultimately, Middlesbrough held firm to secure a 1-0 victory and advance in the Carabao Cup . It was a performance defined by one clinical moment from Lankshear and a solid defensive display that weathered the late storm from the visitors.
